regulators.name: Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development
regulators.scope: Farm registration, Animal Diseases Act 35/1984, controlled disease reporting, vaccine approvals (Act 36)

regulators.name: South African Poultry Association
regulators.scope: Industry standards, biosecurity, husbandry guidelines, technical committees on health/welfare/food compliance

regulators.name: Meat Safety Act 40 of 2000
regulators.scope: Slaughter facilities, transport to abattoir, withdrawal periods

regulators.name: Animals Protection Act 71 of 1962 + welfare guidance
regulators.scope: Humane handling, culling, density, transport stress

regulators.name: State Veterinary Service
regulators.scope: Outbreak reporting (HPAI, Newcastle), movement permits, surveillance

audit_pain_points_observed: Poor sanitation stations (foot baths empty / contaminated)
Weak access control (no visitor log, no last-farm-visited declaration)
Cross-contamination between houses (shared equipment, PPE re-use)

sops.title: Biosecurity & Site Access Control
key_records: Visitor log (name, ID, time-in/out, last farm visited, reason for visit)
Vehicle wash log (registration, time, disinfectant used)
Foot bath chemistry log (chemical, concentration, refresh time, signature)
PPE issue log (type, recipient, batch reference)
failure_modes: Foot bath empty or expired chemistry

sops.title: Day-Old Chick Reception & Brooding
key_records: Hatchery dispatch certificate (batch, parent flock, hatch date, vaccination status)
Reception count and DOA tally
Brooder temperature curve (hourly first 24h)
Light schedule (lux, hours)
Water and feed consumption per 1000 birds
failure_modes: Brooder temperature below 32 °C in first 7 days

sops.title: Vaccination Programme
key_records: Vaccine register (product, batch, expiry, supplier)
Cold-chain log (storage temperature continuous)
Administration register (date, age in days, route, dose, administrator)
Adverse event log (mortality post-vac, anaphylaxis)
HPAI vaccination — DALRRD authorisation reference + weekly surveillance result
diseases_covered: Newcastle Disease (NDV) — La Sota / Mukteswar / clone strains
Marek's Disease (in ovo or day-old subcutaneous)
Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza H5 — only on DALRRD-approved farms (3 vaccines registered SA, 2025)
failure_modes: Vaccine expired at point of administration
Vaccinated bird not surveilled per DALRRD weekly requirement

sops.title: Mortality Recording & Carcass Disposal
key_records: Daily mortality count per house (cull vs natural)
Cumulative mortality % vs SAPA benchmark (0.04%/day broiler, 0.02%/day layer)
Post-mortem trigger threshold (2σ above rolling mean OR > 0.5% in single day)
Disposal method and timestamp (incineration / composting / rendering)
Notifiable disease reporting log (state vet contact, case ref)

reporting_thresholds.spike: Mortality > 2× 7-day rolling mean → flag for vet review same day

failure_modes: Notifiable disease suspect not reported same day
Daily count missing for any house

sops.title: Feed Management & Withdrawal
key_records: Feed delivery register (supplier, batch, vehicle, weight, COA)
Daily consumption per house (kg/1000 birds)
Feed conversion ratio (FCR) calculation per batch
Withdrawal period log (last medicated feed date, abattoir-clear date)
Supplier audit cycle (annual, last audit date)
failure_modes: Medicated feed used inside withdrawal window prior to slaughter
FCR > 1.8 broiler / > 2.2 layer (review nutrition + house environment)

sops.title: Water Quality & Sanitation
key_records: Water meter reading per house (litres/1000 birds, vs feed intake ratio ~1.8:1)
Chlorination log (free chlorine ppm at line end)
Line sanitation between batches (chemical, contact time, flush volume)
6-monthly external water test (E. coli, total coliforms, nitrate, hardness)
failure_modes: Free chlorine > 5 ppm (palatability) or < 0.5 ppm (no efficacy)

sops.title: Litter Management
key_records: Initial litter depth (cm) per house
Turning schedule and timestamp
Moisture % spot-check (< 25% target)
Change-out date and disposal method

sops.title: Lighting & Ventilation Programme
key_records: Photoperiod by age (hours light:dark)
Lux measurement at bird height
Ammonia (NH₃) reading — must be < 25 ppm at bird level
House temperature curve by age
Static pressure (negative-pressure ventilation tightness check)

sops.title: Egg Collection, Sanitation & Grading
key_records: Collections per day (target 4-5x for layer)
Floor egg count (deviation from nest)
Egg wash chemistry (chlorine ppm, temperature, contact time)
Candling reject count (cracks, blood spots, double yolk)
Grade tally (jumbo / extra-large / large / medium / small)
failure_modes: Wash water cooler than egg surface (bacteria pulled inward)
Floor egg count > 2% (nest box training issue)

sops.title: Catching, Loading & Transport to Abattoir
key_records: Feed withdrawal time (target 8-12h pre-catch)
Catch crew composition and PPE issue
Crate loading density (kg/m² per Animal Welfare guidance)
Transport duration and ambient temperature
Mortality on arrival (DOA) — abattoir feedback
failure_modes: Feed withdrawal < 6h (gut contamination at slaughter) or > 14h (welfare)

sops.title: Cleaning & Disinfection Between Batches
key_records: Dry clean (manure removal) — date, signature
Wet clean (high-pressure water + detergent) — chemical, contact time
Disinfection (DALRRD-approved disinfectant) — product, dilution, contact time
Down-time period (target 14 days minimum)
Pre-placement swab test result (Salmonella, E. coli, total bacteria)
failure_modes: Pre-placement swab fails (re-clean required, batch start delayed)

sops.title: Pest & Rodent Control
key_records: Bait station map and inspection log
Wild bird sighting log (HPAI vector control)
Insect monitoring (red mite count for layer)
Contract pest-control service visit log
failure_modes: Bait stations empty / chewed but not refilled
Wild birds inside house perimeter (HPAI risk)
Red mite count rising (anaemia + production drop)

sops.title: Humane Culling Protocol
key_records: Cull justification (sick, injured, depopulation, biosecurity)
Method used (cervical dislocation < 3kg / captive bolt > 3kg / CO₂ gassing for mass)
Operator name and competency record
Verified death (no breathing, no corneal reflex)

sops.title: Daily Flock Register & Record-Keeping
key_records: Date, house number, age in days
Opening count, mortality, culls, closing count
Feed consumption (kg)
Water consumption (litres)
Average bird weight (weekly weighing sample)
Environment readings (temp, NH₃, humidity)
Observations (behaviour, abnormalities, treatments given)
Signature of stockperson
failure_modes: Closing count doesn't reconcile (opening - mortality - culls = close)

sops.title: Visitor & Contractor Protocol
key_records: Pre-visit declaration (last farm visited, date, species)
72-hour exclusion enforced if last visit was poultry
PPE issued (overalls, boots, hairnet, mask)
Shower-in / shower-out compliance
Sign-out time and equipment returned
failure_modes: Visitor entered with < 72h since last poultry farm
Vehicles not parked in designated visitor zone
